items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Back at practice Thursday
items.text:
Egbuka, who was present for practice Thursday, was spotted testing his injured foot, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

items.title: Deebo Samuel: Not likely to play Sunday
items.text:
According to GM John Lynch, Samuel (hamstring) is unlikely to be available for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

items.title: Mike Evans: Likely to sit Sunday per GM
items.text:
Evans (Achilles) isn't expected to play Sunday against the Raiders, 49ers GM John Lynch said on KNBR radio Thursday, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

items.title: Sam Darnold: Considered week-to-week
items.text:
Darnold (quadriceps), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, is considered week-to-week, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.
